description: This file defines the HiveShim object containing utility functions and classes for integrating Hive with Spark, including handling UDFs, serialization, and configuration adjustments.

classes.name: HiveShim.HiveFunctionWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Hive UDF functions, supporting serialization, deserialization, and creation of UDF instances.

methods.name: appendReadColumnNames
methods.description: Appends column names to the Configuration object for Hive query projection.

methods.name: appendReadColumns
methods.description: Adds column IDs and names to the Configuration, handling nulls appropriately.

methods.name: prepareWritable
methods.description: Prepares a Writable object, especially AvroGenericRecordWritable, for serialization by setting schema and IDs.

methods.name: toCatalystDecimal
methods.description: Converts HiveDecimalObjectInspector data to Spark's Decimal type.

methods.name: deserializePlan
methods.description: Deserializes a UDF plan from an InputStream.

methods.name: serializePlan
methods.description: Serializes a UDF plan to an OutputStream.

methods.name: writeExternal
methods.description: Serializes the HiveFunctionWrapper object for external storage.

methods.name: readExternal
methods.description: Deserializes the HiveFunctionWrapper object from external storage.

methods.name: createFunction
methods.description: Creates an instance of the UDF, either from cached instance or by reflection.
